眨眼间，又是8小时过去。

这8小时里，林舒也没闲着。

他尝试通过各种渠道来查清楚这个叫厉雨的男人的来历，而最终，他也在徐长顺留下的记录里发现了些端倪。

就跟自己猜测的一样，对方很可能是来自苗疆的“蛊师”。

他使用的这种泥丸，大概率是一种被称作“疳蛊”的毒粉。

“.......疳蛊常取端午日的小蛇、蜈蚣、蝉、蚂蚁等毒虫，混入头发一起研磨成粉末，捏碎后撒出，即可致人中毒。”

“大部分民间记载中，疳蛊中毒后会导致上吐下泻等肠胃症状，并不致命。”

“但据我考证，疳蛊极有可能导致死亡，之所以近年内未见死亡记录，大概率是因为该蛊术法脉断绝，未流传下完整的制作方法。”

“同时，根据现今流传的疳蛊制作方法可判断，在整个苗疆蛊术体系中，这一门蛊术是为数不多保留了相当程度的‘仪轨色彩’的一门。”

“它的功能上限远高于其他普通的‘制毒法’，如果能恢复，可能重新成为一门有效的‘仪轨’......”

所以，这个厉雨是真的有法脉传承在身的。

他制作害人的蛊毒，也需要通过特定的仪轨实现。

但问题来了----他怎么就不怕天收呢？

他怎么就敢这么随便害人？

徐长顺不是说不讲规矩就要被天收吗？害人还不是不讲规矩？

难道他们有特殊的方法，可以逃脱天收的诅咒吗？

不太可能......

林舒看着阳光照进房间里，又一点点偏移。

那束光从厉雨的脸上掠过，慢慢地扫过了他的身体。

当阳光最终落在他的脚上时，他终于再次醒了过来。

“......算你狠......”

厉雨咬牙切齿，但态度明显已经松动了不少。

“兄弟，扶我起来吧，我身上已经麻了。”

“我觉得我们可以聊，真的可以聊.......”

犹豫片刻，林舒上前扶起了厉雨。

当然，他的蛇始终在一旁虎视眈眈，只要厉雨敢有一点异动，蛇便会立刻咬上去。

坐正之后，厉雨长长吐出了一口气。

“你很厉害......”

他直视着林舒。

“我没想到你那么厉害----这年头，手里有真东西的太少了。”

“你用的是什么？那蛇是怎么回事？”

“梅山术？蛊术？还是道术？”

“我感觉像是收惊、神打之类的......怎么样，能说吗？”

“不能。”

林舒摇摇头。

这人似乎对仪轨体系很熟悉----当然，在他的视角里，这些东西并不叫“仪轨”，而是直接叫做“法术”。

“不能说就不说吧，法脉密不外传，也正常。”

“咱们就.......随便聊聊。”

In the blink of an eye, another 8 hours passed.

During these 8 hours, Lin Shu was not idle either.

He tried to find out the origin of this man named Li Yu through various channels, and in the end, he also found some clues in the records left by Xu Changshun.

Just as I guessed, the other party was probably a "Gu Master" from Miao territory.

The clay pills he used were most likely a poisonous powder called "Ban Gu".

"...The malnutrition gu often takes small snakes, centipedes, cicadas, ants and other poisonous insects on the Dragon Boat Festival, mixes them into the hair and grinds them into powder, crushes them and scatters them, which can cause poisoning."

"In most folk records, malnutrition poisoning can cause gastrointestinal symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhea, and is not fatal."

"But according to my research, malnutrition Gu is very likely to cause death. The reason why there are no death records in recent years is probably because the lineage of this Gu technique has been cut off and the complete production method has not been handed down."

"At the same time, based on the current methods of making the Gu, it can be judged that in the entire Miao Gu art system, this Gu art is one of the few that retains a considerable degree of 'ritual color'."

"The upper limit of its function is much higher than other ordinary 'poison making methods'. If it can be restored, it may become an effective 'ritual' again..."

Therefore, this Li Yu really has the inheritance of the law.

He also needs to go through specific rituals to create harmful poisons.

But here comes the question - why isn't he afraid of heaven's harvest?

How dare he harm people so casually?

Didn't Xu Changshun say that if you don't follow the rules, you will be punished by heaven?Isn't harming people not following the rules?

Do they have a special way to escape Tianshou's curse?

Unlikely...

Lin Shu watched the sunlight shining into the room and shifting away a little bit.

The beam of light passed over Li Yu's face and slowly swept over his body.

When the sun finally fell on his feet, he finally woke up again.

"...You're cruel..."

Li Yu gritted his teeth, but his attitude had obviously relaxed a lot.

"Brother, help me up, I'm already numb."

"I think we can talk, we really can..."

After hesitating for a moment, Lin Shu stepped forward and helped Li Yu up.

Of course, his snake was always watching eagerly from the side. As long as Li Yu dared to make the slightest move, the snake would bite him immediately.

After sitting up straight, Li Yu let out a long breath.

"You are very powerful..."

He looked directly at Lin Shu.

"I didn't expect you to be that powerful - these days, there are too few people with real things in their hands."

"What did you use? What happened to the snake?"

"Meishan Technique? Gu Technique? Or Taoist Technique?"

"I feel like I was frightened, struck by a god, etc... How about it, can you tell me?"

"Can't."

Lin Shu shook his head.

This person seems to be very familiar with the ritual system - of course, from his perspective, these things are not called "rituals", but directly called "spells".

"If you can't say it, just say it. It's normal that the Dharma lineage is secret and not spread to others."

"Let's just... have a casual chat."
